import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from src import stats

def check(name, fn, expect):
    try:
        got = fn()
    except Exception as e:
        got = ("exc", type(e).__name__)
    ok = got == expect
    print(("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"), name, "expected", expect, "got", got)
    return ok

results = []
results.append(check("mean([])", lambda: stats.mean([]), ("exc", "ValueError")))
results.append(check("median([])", lambda: stats.median([]), ("exc", "ValueError")))
results.append(check("mean([1,2,3])", lambda: stats.mean([1,2,3]), 2.0))
results.append(check("median odd [3,1,2]", lambda: stats.median([3,1,2]), 2))
results.append(check("median even [1,2,3,4]", lambda: stats.median([1,2,3,4]), 2.5))
results.append(check("mode([1,2,2,3])", lambda: stats.mode([1,2,2,3]), 2))
results.append(check("mode tie->smallest [1,1,2,2]", lambda: stats.mode([1,1,2,2]), 1))
results.append(check("mode([])", lambda: stats.mode([]), ("exc", "ValueError")))
results.append(check("stdev([2,4,4,4,5,5,7,9])", lambda: stats.stdev([2,4,4,4,5,5,7,9]), 2.0))
results.append(check("stdev([1])", lambda: stats.stdev([1]), 0.0))
results.append(check("stdev([])", lambda: stats.stdev([]), ("exc", "ValueError")))

src = [3,1,2]
stats.median(src)
results.append(check("non-destructive median", lambda: src, [3,1,2]))
src2 = [1,1,2]
stats.mode(src2)
results.append(check("non-destructive mode", lambda: src2, [1,1,2]))

print()
print("TOTAL PASS:", sum(results), "/", len(results))
print("HAS mode:", hasattr(stats, "mode"), "HAS stdev:", hasattr(stats, "stdev"))
